title: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 3: Blue Emperor
native_title: アクアゾーン・オプション・ディスク・シリーズ３ ～ブルー・エンペラー～
overview: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 3: Blue Emperor is a Sega Saturn simulation game released exclusively in Japan. It is not technically a game, but rather a tropical fish simulator.
